observations: White microwave oven with a black control panel and door frame.
Brand 'AKAI' is clearly visible on the control panel in photos 0, 1, 2, and 3.
Control panel features two rotary knobs: one for power levels (M.Low, Low, Med, M.High, High, Combi.1, Combi.2, Combi.3) and one for timer/defrost.
The interior contains a glass turntable and a metal grill rack.
The exterior casing shows some surface dirt and minor scuffs in photo 2.
The door glass appears clean in photos 0 and 1.

claims.evidence: The exterior shows some dirt and scuffs, which is consistent with use.

claims.claim: Had bigger alternatives so didn't quite use this one much
Bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.
